cleanExplanation: The mass of sodium bicarbonate is 46.30 - 42.10 = 4.20 g, which is 4.20/84.01 = 0.0500 mol. Because one mole of NaHCO3 gives one mole of NaCl, the theoretical mass of NaCl is 0.0500 x 58.44 = 2.92 g. The actual residue is 45.02 - 42.10 = 2.92 g, so the percent yield is (2.92/2.92) x 100 = 99.9%, essentially complete conversion, and the 1.28 g mass loss matches the amount of HCO3-/CO2 and water driven off. The closest listed value is 101.4%.
